name: mods
description: Function-hook mods for the Claude Code harness: a git write gate that asks the person, not the model; a guard that refuses commits and pushes on the default branch; a status band with the location, model, context, 5-hour and weekly usage, and the branch's PR and the PRs opened this session, each with its review state, threads, CI and whether it is ready to merge; a plan line with the main agent's declared task progress and the active task; a toast when a usage limit nears its cap; a /pr pane with buttons into the PR skills; a checklist of whether simplify, code-review, pr-review and prune-comments ran on each PR; a guard that refuses credentials in tracked files; the reply-style rule as a system-prompt section; a /skill-tally of which skills actually fire; and time awareness: the local time, time away and slow tool calls, told to the model. Each one has a switch in /config.

gitGate.title: Git write gate
gitGate.description: Ask the person before git commit, git push, gh pr create and gh pr merge run

branchGuard.title: Default-branch guard
branchGuard.description: Refuse git commit and git push on the repository's default branch, unless the git command is prefixed with ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_WRITE=1

statusBand.title: Status band
statusBand.description: Show the location, branch, model, context use, 5-hour and weekly usage, the branch's PR and the PRs opened this session above the prompt

planProgress.title: Plan progress
planProgress.description: Show the main agent's plan in the status band: its phase, how many tasks it marked completed, and the task in progress. Needs the status band

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Toast when a 5-hour or weekly usage limit passes 90%, once per window

prPane.title: PR pane
prPane.description: Add /pr, a pane with the branch's PR checks, open review threads and the PR skills

ruleGuard.title: Rule guard
ruleGuard.description: Refuse edits that put a credential in a tracked file, or a blocked term in a marketplace repository

blockedTerms.title: Blocked terms
blockedTerms.description: Comma-separated terms, such as employer names, that the rule guard refuses in files of a repository with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json

replyStyle.title: Reply style
replyStyle.description: Add the Simplified Technical English reply rule to the system prompt

prSkills.title: PR skill checklist
prSkills.description: Show on each open PR's band row and in /pr whether simplify, code-review, pr-review and prune-comments have run on it

skillTally.title: Skill tally
skillTally.description: Count each skill that loads, across sessions, and show the counts with /skill-tally

timeAwareness.title: Time awareness
timeAwareness.description: Tell the model the local time with each prompt, how long the session sat idle when it was away 30 minutes or more, and how long a tool call took when it ran 10 seconds or more
